title: Recall Desk study starter
description: General study starter. Replace demonstration content and source placeholders before assessment.

phases.title: Phase 0 — Establish a baseline
phases.description: Complete the diagnostic with confidence and familiarity annotations. Preserve the original answers.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Review the evidence
phases.description: Review reasoning by objective. Select up to three active repair targets; keep the remainder parked.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Repair specific gaps
phases.description: Read the smallest relevant guide section, predict a changed scenario, and record the corrected distinction.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Apply the concepts
phases.description: Use a small lab, exercise, or relevant course activity. Record expected versus observed behavior.

phases.title: Phase 4 — Confirm transfer and coverage
phases.description: Use fresh scenarios and acknowledge objectives with insufficient evidence. Avoid treating recognition as mastery.

phases.title: Phase 5 — Integrate and rehearse
phases.description: Connect concepts in a complete scenario. Use a fresh assessment and review pacing if relevant.

modules.title: Targeted concept repair
modules.description: Optional: repair one demonstrated gap and explain a close alternative.

modules.title: Small applied check
modules.description: Optional: predict and observe one normal and one failure path.

modules.title: Fresh transfer check
modules.description: Optional: change the assumptions and explain the new outcome.

warnings: Starter contains a labeled demonstration question. Replace it and the source placeholders before using it for actual study.
